items.summary: Recommendation: reject all new queue and production work this cycle. Preserve the existing Great American Lakes and SEO measurement work, keep SearchWoot private, and await recorded measurement thresholds plus affiliate-attribution reconciliation. No site-level ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or revenue claim is supported because attribution is incomplete, telemetry is low-volume, no outcomes are proven, and prior implementation attempts failed. Approve waiting for these evidence gates before authorizing further implementation?
